paragraphs.text: Teedmar was a dwarf mining town in the Crimson Peaks of Sarpadia , on the world of Dominaria .

Teedmar was located in the northwestern part of the Crimson Peaks , near Gurn Keep and not far from the border to Icatia . The town was based around the trade of mining and refining ore into metals, and the forging of weapons from those metals. These weapons supplied Gurn Keep with an arsenal, and the trade was strong enough that it worried agents of the Ebon Hand . Setting off a volcanic eruption in the mountain next to Teedmar, the Ebon Hand destroyed the town completely. This act was witnessed by Reod Dai and Eliza from a dark bubble, a sort of magical pocket realm created by a priest of Tourach . Tamun and her mother Melelki were also present, although far underground in a passage leading away from the city. This saved them, as the passage behind the collapsed, while the way ahead remained clear of rubble.
